full_key_compromise.boundary: Composed-signature validity is evidence about the key set, not about key custody or fact truth; chain-plus-SEI inherits key custody as an unregistered premise.

cost_reduction.reading: ORION spends 2.8x the reads, the opposite direction to the gate

recall_noninferiority.reading: the point estimate -0.0177 sits inside the -0.02 margin, but the interval's lower bound does not. Noninferiority is a claim about the interval, so reporting the point estimate alone would pass a gate the evidence does not

gate.gate: recall@100 noninferior within -0.02 to the best comparator; >=25% fewer candidates/tool calls with CI lower bound >=10%; no increase in premature-stop error
gate.inference_unit: topic; paired over the 50 TREC-COVID topics, 10k bootstrap resamples

not_a_gate_criterion_but_measured.reading: multi-route exploration raises top-10 quality substantially and the interval excludes zero, but the gate is written on recall and cost, and a criterion not in the gate cannot rescue it

primary_comparisons.note: Point-estimate margin flags are descriptive. Publication inference must also report the paired confidence intervals and the frozen protocol.

replay_boundary.boundary: the fix restores replay-channel consistency, not the validity of the prior-valued 0.5 as a representation measurement; D1v1.3 ORDERED_MULTIPLICITY_ROBUSTNESS remains the frozen scientific successor (PROSPECTIVE_FROZEN_NOT_EXECUTED, protected inputs absent)
